brief: NSE and BSE are shut today for Guru Nanak Jayanti, so there is no Indian cash trading, while Wall Street rallied hard after Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia. Tata Sons' decision on going public this week and the market reaction to Tata Steel's APL Apollo deal are the main Indian stories to watch.
